acceptanceCriteria: a preflight detects the enclosing-sandbox refusal once and the request reports it as one supported-limit reason
no mutant ever runs unsandboxed; a test pins both
body: Found by the V1-0547 spike (PR #963, 2026-10-16). HostSandbox only looks up /usr/bin/sandbox-exec. Inside a nested `codex sandbox -P :workspace`, sandbox-exec exits 71 and every run reports `mutate: sandbox unavailable: the host refused to apply the sandbox-exec profile` (TCQ-V0-059 / V1-0651 supported limit). Expected: a single preflight that detects the nested refusal up front and reports one not-run reason, instead of spending each run on it. Enforcement must not be relaxed.
